description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named LeaveRequestCommentSearchFilterParams used for filtering search results related to leave request comments, specifically including a leave request ID filter and inheriting date range filtering functionality.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering leave request comment search results, including sorting options and an optional leave request ID filter.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Returns the leave request ID filter value, which can be null.

methods.name: setLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Sets the leave request ID filter value.
